author: Tikai
body:
I was banned from Avicus around 5-6 months ago.
I was banned by " Tazz " but he's retired now so that caused some problems.

Um, to start with, after my 1st appeal I was told to wait 1-2 months to be unbanned and I waited then appealed again but didn't talk much about my actual ban, just my tourney ban and it caused some confusion because Tazz retired so he wasn't reviewing my appeal.
 I sent an email and was told that'd I had to wait another month to be appealed but exams kinda got in the way so I wasn't able to do so until now.
I'd like to be unbanned to be apart of my team and community again, no other reasons. If you could help with this, I'd be grateful.

Regards,
Omega

replies.body:

Regards,

replies.author: Tikai
replies.body: So, is my appeal denied? Or do I have to email them again and they'll tell me to come back and appeal here again? And, sorry if I'm being rude, but can you actually reply...?
replies.body_tagged: So, is my appeal denied? Or do I have to email them again and they'll tell me to come back and appeal here again? And, sorry if I'm being rude, but can you actually reply...?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
It's a tournament ban so we can't do anything. It's the officials job to unban you and handle the appeal. To solve this situation, I have contacted the admins and they should reply here soon. Just be patient.

Also regarding your ban, this is the ban in the tournament. This ban was made by the officials during the tournament which is the reason why the officials handle it.
